system.description:
You spend your entire turn focusing and weaving hand seals to achieve a state of absolute focus. You create a massive Cage of Fire capturing all inside the radius of the jutsu. Select a point you can see within range. A cage of flame manifests covering a 30ft cube centered on the chosen point. All creatures within the affected area are trapped inside the cage of Fire.

Creatures attempting to cross the cages walls must make a Strength saving throw.

On a Strength save failure, the target creature is pushed back 10 feet in a straight line and takes 4d10+4 Fire damage as they are unable to breach the cages perimeter.

If a creature passes their Strength saving throw and is able to breach the perimeter, then they must make a constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target creature gains 2 ranks of Burn.
